field.name: title
field.comment: The text displayed above the video

field.name: videoURL
field.comment: The address of the video on YouTube, from which its identifier is taken

field.name: vHeight
field.comment: The height of the player, in pixels (used if sizing is fixed)

field.name: vWidth
field.comment: The width of the player, in pixels (used if sizing is fixed)

field.name: sizing
field.comment: 16:9 or 4:3: the player fills the width available, keeping that ratio; fixed: it's vWidth by vHeight pixels

field.name: startTimeEnabled
field.comment: true: the video starts at startTime; false or NULL: it starts from the beginning

field.name: startTime
field.comment: Where the playback starts, as 1h2m3s or as 1:02:03 (used if startTimeEnabled is true)

field.name: noCookie
field.comment: true: the video is loaded from youtube-nocookie.com, which doesn't track the visitors; false or NULL: it's loaded from youtube.com

field.name: autoplay
field.comment: true: the video starts as soon as the page is displayed; false: the visitor starts it

field.name: color
field.comment: red: the progress bar of the player is red; white: it's white

field.name: controls
field.comment: true: the player displays its controls; false or NULL: they are hidden

field.name: iv_load_policy
field.comment: 1: the annotations of the video are displayed; 3: they are hidden

field.name: loopEnd
field.comment: true: the video starts over when it ends; false: it stops

field.name: modestbranding
field.comment: true: the YouTube logo is kept out of the controls; false: it's displayed

field.name: lazyLoad
field.comment: true: the player is loaded only when it's about to be displayed; false: it's loaded right away

field.name: rel
field.comment: true: the videos offered when the playback ends come from other channels too; false: they come from the same channel

field.name: showCaptions
field.comment: true: the captions of the video are displayed; false: they are hidden
